    RETURNS TRIGGER
    AS $$
    BEGIN
        UPDATE loan_summary
        SET total_loan_count = (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM loan
            WHERE loan.account_id = loan_summary.account_id
              AND loan.status = 'A')
        WHERE loan_summary.account_id = NEW.account_id;
        RETURN NEW;
    END;
    $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH cte AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           TO_DATE(purchase_date || '-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AS date_as_date
    FROM purchase
), islands AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN LAG(date_as_date) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY date_as_date) + INTERVAL '1 month' <> date_as_date
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END AS new_partition
    FROM cte
), partitioned_islands AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           SUM(new_partition) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY date_as_date) AS partitions
    FROM islands
), count_per_island AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_consecutive_dates
    FROM partitioned_islands
    GROUP BY user_id, partitions
    ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC)
    FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
)
SELECT num_consecutive_dates AS streakLength,
       COUNT(*) AS numOfOccurrences
FROM count_per_island
GROUP BY streakLength
ORDER BY streakLength DESC

WITH card_activity AS (
  SELECT
    to_date(fe.start_date_key::text, 'YYYYMMDD') AS start_date,
    to_date(fe.end_date_key::text, 'YYYYMMDD') AS end_date,
    dp.set_name,
    dp.set_code,
    fe.set_key
  FROM fact_collection fe
  INNER JOIN dim_set dp ON fe.set_key = dp.set_key
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', month_series) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fe.card_key) AS existing_cards,
  sa.set_name
FROM (
  SELECT
    generate_series(
      (SELECT MIN(to_date(start_date_key::text, 'YYYYMMDD')) FROM fact_collection),
      '2100-12-31',
      INTERVAL '1 month'
    ) AS month_series
) AS months
LEFT JOIN card_activity sa ON

  (sa.end_date IS NULL OR sa.end_date >= month_series)
LEFT JOIN fact_collection fe ON
  fe.set_key = sa.set_key

  AND (fe.end_date_key IS NULL OR fe.end_date_key >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month_series) * 10000 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month_series) * 100 + 1)
GROUP BY month, sa.set_name

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_superhero_ids()
  RETURNS SETOF jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    cols   text;    -- Will hold the comma-separated list of matching columns
    sqlstr text;    -- Will hold the final SQL statement
BEGIN
    SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(column_name), ', ')
      INTO cols
      FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_name = 'superhero'
       AND column_name LIKE '%_id';

    IF cols IS NULL THEN
        -- No columns matched; return nothing
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    sqlstr := format(
        'SELECT to_jsonb(row) 
         FROM (SELECT %s 
               FROM %I) AS row',
        cols,
        'superhero'
    );
    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE sqlstr;
END;
$$;

        WHERE table_name = 'curricula'
          AND column_name = 'status'
    ) THEN

    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'educational_resources'
          AND column_name = 'status'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE educational_resources ADD COLUMN status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''installed''';
    END IF;
END$$;



WITH RECURSIVE connected_curricula AS (

SELECT c.curriculum_id
    FROM curricula c
    WHERE c.curriculum_id = 1
AND c.status = 'installed'
UNION
SELECT cr2.curriculum_id
    FROM connected_curricula cte
    JOIN curriculum_resources cr1
         ON cr1.curriculum_id = cte.curriculum_id
    JOIN curriculum_resources cr2
         ON cr2.resource_key = cr1.resource_key
    WHERE cr2.curriculum_id <> cte.curriculum_id
),
updated_curricula AS (
    UPDATE curricula
    SET status = 'to upgrade'
    WHERE curriculum_id IN (SELECT curriculum_id FROM connected_curricula)
    RETURNING curriculum_id
),
updated_resources AS (
    UPDATE educational_resources er
    SET status = 'to upgrade'
    WHERE er.resource_key IN (
      SELECT cr.resource_key
      FROM curriculum_resources cr
      JOIN connected_curricula cc
        ON cr.curriculum_id = cc.curriculum_id
    )
    RETURNING resource_key
)

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated_curricula) AS curricula_updated,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated_resources) AS resources_updated;

WITH working_hours AS (
    SELECT
        ru.learner_code,
        ru.resource_key,
        ru.start_timestamp,
        ru.end_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN date_part('isodow', ru.start_timestamp) IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) THEN ru.start_timestamp + INTERVAL '9 hours'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS working_start,
        CASE
            WHEN date_part('isodow', ru.end_timestamp) IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) THEN ru.end_timestamp + INTERVAL '18 hours'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS working_end
    FROM event_usage ru
)
SELECT
    working_hours.learner_code,
    working_hours.resource_key,
    SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ru.end_timestamp - ru.start_timestamp))) AS total_time_spent_in_working_hours
FROM working_hours
JOIN event_usage ru

FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event

        )

    WHERE a.link_to_event = 'rec2N69DMcrqN9PJC'
    GROUP BY a.link_to_event
) AS largest_cost ON largest_cost.link_to_event = e.event_id

WITH RECURSIVE cte(root, entityid, parentid, entity_emission, pctcontribution) AS (
    SELECT entityid, entityid, COALESCE(parentid, entityid), emission, pctcontribution
    FROM tree_table
    WHERE parentid IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cte.root, t.entityid, t.parentid, t.emission, t.pctcontribution
    FROM cte
    INNER JOIN tree_table AS t ON (t.parentid = cte.entityid)
),
grid AS (
    SELECT
        x.root,
        x.entityid,
        x.parentid,
        x.entity_emission,
        x.groupid,
        x.cumulative_total,
        x.pctcontribution,
        CASE
            WHEN x.entityid = x.root THEN 0
            WHEN x.entityid <> x.root AND x.entityid <> x.groupid AND x.groupid = x.root THEN
                CAST(x.entity_emission * (100 - x.pctcontribution) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(100, 0)
            WHEN x.entityid <> x.root AND x.entityid = x.groupid THEN
                CAST(LAG(x.entity_emission * (100 - x.pctcontribution)) OVER (PARTITION BY x.root, x.groupid ORDER BY x.entityid NULLS FIRST) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(100, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_correction
    FROM (
        SELECT
            root,
            entityid,
            parentid,
            entity_emission,
            COALESCE(LAG(parentid) OVER (ORDER BY root NULLS FIRST, parentid NULLS FIRST, entityid NULLS FIRST), parentid) AS groupid,
            CAST(
                CASE
                    WHEN entityid = root THEN SUM(entity_emission) OVER (PARTITION BY root)
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(LAG(parentid) OVER (ORDER BY entityid NULLS FIRST), parentid) = parentid THEN entity_emission
                            ELSE SUM(entity_emission) OVER (PARTITION BY root ORDER BY entityid NULLS FIRST)
                        END
                END
            AS NUMERIC) AS cumulative_total,
            pctcontribution
        FROM cte
        ORDER BY entityid NULLS FIRST
    ) AS x
)
SELECT
    g.entityid,
    g.parentid,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN g.entityid = g.root THEN
                (SUM(CASE WHEN g.entityid <> g.root THEN g.corrected_contribution ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY g.root) +
                (MAX(CASE WHEN g.entityid = g.root THEN g.entity_emission ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY g.root)) -
                SUM(g.group_correction) OVER (PARTITION BY g.root))
            WHEN g.entityid <> g.root AND g.entityid <> g.groupid AND g.groupid = g.root THEN g.entity_emission
            WHEN g.entityid <> g.root AND g.entityid <> g.groupid THEN g.entity_emission
            WHEN g.entityid <> g.root AND g.entityid = g.groupid THEN g.corrected_contribution
            ELSE 0
        END
    AS NUMERIC) AS cumulative_contribution_total
FROM (
    SELECT
        g.root,
        g.entityid,
        g.parentid,
        g.entity_emission,
        g.groupid,
        g.cumulative_total,
        g.pctcontribution,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN g.entityid = g.root THEN SUM(g.entity_emission - g.contribution_correction) OVER (PARTITION BY g.root)
                WHEN g.entityid <> g.root AND g.entityid <> g.groupid AND g.groupid = g.root THEN g.cumulative_total - g.contribution_correction
                WHEN g.entityid <> g.root AND g.entityid = g.groupid THEN g.cumulative_total - g.contribution_correction
                ELSE 0
            END
        AS NUMERIC) AS corrected_contribution,
        CASE
            WHEN g.entityid <> g.root AND g.entityid = g.groupid THEN
                MAX(CASE
                    WHEN g.entityid <> g.root AND g.entityid = g.groupid THEN
                        CAST((g.cumulative_total - g.contribution_correction) * (100 - g.pctcontribution) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(100, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END) OVER (PARTITION BY g.root, g.groupid)
            ELSE 0
        END AS group_correction
    FROM grid AS g
    ORDER BY g.root NULLS FIRST, g.groupid NULLS FIRST, g.entityid NULLS FIRST
) AS g

    UNION ALL

    UNION ALL
    SELECT TO_DATE('27.03.2023', 'DD.MM.YYYY')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TO_DATE('10.04.2023', 'DD.MM.YYYY')
),

t2 AS (
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'Mon-YY') AS act_month,
        TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'YYYYMM') AS rn_2
    FROM tbl t
    GROUP BY
        TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'Mon-YY'),
        TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'YYYYMM')
    ORDER BY TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'YYYYMM')
),

grid AS (
    SELECT
        t1.activation_month,
        t1.rn_1,
        t2.act_month,
        t2.rn_2
    FROM
        (SELECT
            TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'Mon-YY') AS activation_month,
            TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'YYYYMM') AS rn_1
        FROM tbl t
        GROUP BY
            TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'Mon-YY'),
            TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'YYYYMM')
        ORDER BY TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'YYYYMM')) t1
    LEFT JOIN
        t2
        ON (t1.rn_1 <= t2.rn_2)
),

molecule_activity AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        TO_CHAR(t.act_date, 'YYYYMM') AS act_date
    FROM tbl t
    INNER JOIN
        molecule m
        ON
            m.molecule_id IN
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
                FROM bond
                UNION
                SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
                FROM atom
            )
)

SELECT
    g.activation_month,
    g.act_month,
    CASE
        WHEN g.rn_1 = g.rn_2
            THEN
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ma.molecule_id)
                    FROM molecule_activity ma
                    WHERE ma.act_date = g.rn_1
                )
        ELSE
            (
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ma.molecule_id)
                FROM molecule_activity ma
                WHERE ma.act_date BETWEEN g.rn_1 AND g.rn_2
            )
    END AS active_molecules
FROM grid g
ORDER BY
    g.rn_1,
    g.rn_2

WITH "my_table" AS (
    SELECT 'A' AS "cto", 1 AS "nif", 'A1' AS "file_", 5 AS "filesize"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'A' AS "cto", 1 AS "nif", 'A2' AS "file_", 3 AS "filesize"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'A' AS "cto", 2 AS "nif", 'A3' AS "file_", 2 AS "filesize"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'A' AS "cto", 2 AS "nif", 'A4' AS "file_", 1 AS "filesize"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B' AS "cto", 1 AS "nif", 'B1' AS "file_", 4 AS "filesize"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B' AS "cto", 1 AS "nif", 'B2' AS "file_", 6 AS "filesize"
),
ranked_data AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cto" ORDER BY SUBSTRING("file_", 1, 1), CAST(SUBSTRING("file_", 2) AS INTEGER)) AS "rn",
        SUM("filesize") OVER (PARTITION BY "nif") AS "nif_size"
    FROM "my_table" t
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        rd.*,
        LAG(rd."nif", 1, rd."nif") OVER (PARTITION BY rd."cto" ORDER BY rd."rn") AS "prev_nif"
    FROM ranked_data rd
),
partition_groups AS (
    SELECT
        wl.*,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wl."nif" != wl."prev_nif" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            OVER (PARTITION BY wl."cto" ORDER BY wl."rn") AS "nif_group",
        SUM(wl."filesize") OVER (PARTITION BY wl."cto" ORDER BY wl."rn") AS "running_total"
    FROM with_lag wl
),
group_totals AS (
    SELECT
        pg.*,
        SUM(pg."filesize") OVER (PARTITION BY pg."cto", pg."nif_group" ORDER BY pg."rn" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "group_running_total"
    FROM partition_groups pg
),
partition_boundaries AS (
    SELECT
        gt.*,
        LEAD(gt."nif_size", 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY gt."cto" ORDER BY gt."rn") AS "next_nif_size",
        CASE
            WHEN LEAD(gt."nif_size", 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY gt."cto" ORDER BY gt."rn") +
                 (gt."running_total" - gt."group_running_total") <= 10
            THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END AS "new_partition"
    FROM group_totals gt
),
partitions_with_sum AS (
    SELECT
        pb.*,
        SUM(pb."new_partition") OVER (PARTITION BY pb."cto" ORDER BY pb."rn") AS "partition"
    FROM partition_boundaries pb
),
partitions AS (
    SELECT
        pws.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pws."cto", pws."partition" ORDER BY pws."rn") AS "subpartition",
        SUM(pws."filesize") OVER (PARTITION BY pws."cto", pws."partition") AS "total_size"
    FROM partitions_with_sum pws
)
SELECT
    "cto",
    "nif",
    "file_",
    "partition" + 1 AS "partition",
    "subpartition" AS "subpartition",
    "total_size"
FROM partitions
WHERE "partition" < 7
ORDER BY "cto", "rn";

WITH max_tally AS (
    SELECT MAX(c) AS max_count
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM results
        GROUP BY driverid
    ) r
),
dynamic_query AS (
    SELECT string_agg(
        format('MAX(CASE WHEN rn = %s THEN points END) AS race%s_points', t.i, t.i),
        E',\n       '
    ) AS pivot_columns
    FROM max_tally,
         generate_series(1, (SELECT max_count FROM max_tally)) AS t(i)
)
SELECT format(
    'SELECT driverid,
       %s
FROM (SELECT raceid,
           driverid,
           points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY raceid) AS rn
    FROM results) AS rns
GROUP BY driverid;',
    (SELECT pivot_columns FROM dynamic_query)
) AS sql_to_execute;

DO $$
DECLARE
    sql_statement text;
BEGIN
    WITH max_tally AS (
        SELECT MAX(c) AS max_count
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS c
            FROM results
            GROUP BY driverid
        ) r
    ),
    dynamic_query AS (
        SELECT string_agg(
            format('MAX(CASE WHEN rn = %s THEN points END) AS race%s_points', t.i, t.i),
            E',\n       '
        ) AS pivot_columns
        FROM max_tally,
             generate_series(1, (SELECT max_count FROM max_tally)) AS t(i)
    )
    SELECT format(
        'SELECT driverid,
           %s
        FROM (SELECT raceid,
                   driverid,
                   points,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driverid ORDER BY raceid) AS rn
            FROM results) AS rns
        GROUP BY driverid;',
        (SELECT pivot_columns FROM dynamic_query)
    ) INTO sql_statement;

    EXECUTE sql_statement;
END $$;

WITH rns AS (
    SELECT
        raceid,
        driverid,
        points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY driverid
            ORDER BY raceid
        ) AS rn
    FROM results
)
SELECT
